csv_project_name: Landscape Engrg For Springfield Hospital McKeldin Courtyard
csv_scope_of_work: Springfield Hospital Center (SHC) is seeking a qualified engineering and conservation landscaping firm to design, plan, and oversee the transformation of the McKeldin Courtyard into a therapeutic pollinator garden. The selected contractor will be responsible for all phases of project implementation, including site assessment, master plan development, demolition, construction, and landscape installation. The goal of this project is to create an environmentally sustainable, restorative outdoor space that provides therapeutic benefits for SHC patients, staff, and visitors.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning

title: Landscape Engineering for Springfield Hospital McKeldin Courtyard
short_description: Therapeutic pollinator garden redesign and landscape implementation at Springfield Hospital Center.

project_scope: Transformation of the McKeldin Courtyard into a therapeutic pollinator garden at Springfield Hospital Center. Scope includes site assessment, master plan development, demolition, construction, landscape installation, and oversight of implementation to create an environmentally sustainable restorative outdoor space for patients, staff, and visitors.
services: Landscape architecture, civil engineering, land use planning, planning/master planning, design, project implementation oversight, demolition coordination, construction oversight, and landscape installation.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a landscape architecture and courtyard garden project, not a structural engineering project.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure is indicated.
- Falls under pure urban/open space planning and landscape design, which is explicitly not of interest.
- No meaningful structural design component relevant to sbp is described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The source only describes a courtyard landscape transformation with site assessment, master planning, demolition, construction, and planting, but provides no area, quantities, or budget basis for a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As the project is primarily landscape architecture/open space planning and not relevant to sbp's core structural services, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering and conservation landscaping firm; requested disciplines include landscape architecture, civil engineering, land use planning, and planning/master planning.
contracting_authority: Spring Grove Hospital Center, Maryland. Contact: Sherida Studwood. Email: sherida.studwood1@maryland.gov. Phone: 410-402-7098.
notes: Advance notice only. The RFP/Q has been canceled and may be re-advertised in the future. IMS requested no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time. Despite the hospital setting, the tender concerns courtyard landscape works rather than building or structural engineering services.
